motion_system: A fast diagonal procession: socket rims breathe in staggered measure cuts, scratch grain brightens on hover, and lower-field ridges press outward as if bass is trapped beneath the metal.
color_drift: Mostly pale aluminum and graphite, drifting through off-white flash, muted amber warmth, cold lavender specks, blue-green pin-glints, and faint pitch-color shadows in apertures.
glow_behavior: No neon wash; only flash glints, polished chamfer sparks, and tiny interior reflections inside slits and connector mouths.
